name: Keza
face: Young Burundian girl with warm medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright open smile.
clothing: One-shoulder ankle-length mushanana in red and white diagonal stripes with a green panel, a green sash, a yellow flower buckle, and a short gold fringe. Simple brown sandals.
proportions: Storybook child, about eight years old, with a slightly large head, slender arms, and a small stature beside adults.
distinctiveFeatures: Big rounded dark curly afro, mushanana draped over one shoulder, yellow flower at the waist, gold fringe, bare of any hat or jewelry except the flower buckle.
